skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 3 combo strikes for 70% ATK DMG each, with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the target for 2 turns (when attacked, takes additional Injury DMG equal to 75% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 3 combo strikes for 85% ATK DMG each, with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the target for 2 turns (when attacked, takes additional Injury DMG equal to 100% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After taking action, grants [Tenacity] to surrounding allies (absorbs DMG equal to 15% of own HP).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After taking action, grants [Tenacity] to surrounding allies and self (absorbs DMG equal to 15% of own HP).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. After taking action, grants [Tenacity] to surrounding allies and self (absorbs DMG equal to 20% of own HP).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
